patterns.reminder: AGENTS.md Supabase boundary: feature/app code must not import @supabase/supabase-js directly. Use src/lib/supabase wrappers or src/lib/query hooks.
service_role marker found outside supabase/functions and src/lib/supabase. Service role keys must never appear in client/feature code.
Possible hardcoded JWT (eyJ... prefix). Load from env / EAS secrets — never commit tokens to source.
Hardcoded Supabase publishable key. Use environment configuration (expo-constants / EAS secrets).
AGENTS.md observability boundary: feature/app code must not call Sentry directly. Use src/lib/observability wrappers that scrub PII before send.
AGENTS.md observability boundary: feature/app code must not call PostHog directly. Use src/lib/analytics wrappers.

AGENTS.md forbids @ts-ignore without an ADR. This reviewer treats @ts-nocheck as equivalent because it disables file-level type checking. These directives silently suppress type errors and can hide validation gaps at trust boundaries. Prefer fixing the type, narrowing with Zod, or using @ts-expect-error (which fails if the expected error disappears).

@ts-expect-error in production code: confirm it points at a tracked upstream bug or ADR. Unlike @ts-ignore, @ts-expect-error fails when the expected error disappears, so it is a legitimate tool — but each production use should have a comment linking the reason.
AGENTS.md Boundaries: `as unknown as` requires an ADR. Double-casts often hide Zod validation gaps and bypass type-level safety guarantees.
AGENTS.md Boundaries: explicit `any` in contracts / query / supabase code requires an ADR. `any` here can bypass runtime validation. Use a Zod-validated type.
AGENTS.md design boundary: feature/app code must not import raw Pressable. Use src/design primitives — they bundle haptics, a11y states, touch targets, and Dynamic Type.

AGENTS.md Non-Negotiables: ios/ and android/ are generated by Expo prebuild/EAS and not edited directly. Changes here are wiped on next prebuild and historically have leaked signing identifiers/entitlements.
AGENTS.md state boundary: Zustand is for UI/workflow state only. Server-derived rows belong in TanStack Query — Zustand can let stale auth-scoped data leak across user sessions.
